title: Jehoram’s Reign

questions.question: Who succeeded Jehoshaphat?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:1 (ESV): "Jehoshaphat... was buried with his fathers in the city of David, and Jehoram his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: What did Jehoram do to his brothers?
options: He killed all of them with the sword
questions.correctAnswer: He killed all of them with the sword
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:4 (ESV): "...he killed all his brothers with the sword..."

questions.question: Who was Jehoram's wife?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:6 (ESV): "...for he had the daughter of Ahab as wife..."

questions.question: Why did the LORD not destroy the house of David?
options: Because of the covenant that he had made with David
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the covenant that he had made with David
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:7 (ESV): "Yet the LORD was not willing to destroy the house of David, because of the covenant..."

questions.question: Who revolted against Judah related to Edom?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:8 (ESV): "In his days Edom revolted from the rule of Judah..."

questions.question: Who sent a letter to Jehoram?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:12 (ESV): "And a letter came to him from Elijah the prophet..."

questions.question: What did the letter prophecy?
options: Great plague on your people and a severe disease of your bowels
questions.correctAnswer: Great plague on your people and a severe disease of your bowels
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:14-15 (ESV): "Behold, the LORD will bring a great plague... and you yourself will have a severe sickness with a disease of your bowels..."

questions.question: Who stirred up against Jehoram?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:16 (ESV): "And the LORD stirred up against Jehoram the anger of the Philistines and of the Arabians..."

questions.question: Who was the only son left to Jehoram?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:17 (ESV): "...so that no son was left to him except Jehoahaz, his youngest son."

questions.question: What happened to Jehoram after two years of sickness?
options: His bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great agony
questions.correctAnswer: His bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great agony
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:19 (ESV): "...his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great agony."

questions.question: How old was Jehoram when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:20 (ESV): "He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What city revolted at the same time as Edom?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:10 (ESV): "At that time Libnah also revolted from his rule..."

questions.question: Why did Libnah revolt?
options: Because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers
questions.correctAnswer: Because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:10 (ESV): "...because he had forsaken the LORD, the God of his fathers."

questions.question: How was Jehoram buried?
options: Without being desired/regretted, in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings
questions.correctAnswer: Without being desired/regretted, in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:20 (ESV): "He departed with no one's regret. They buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings."

questions.question: Did they make a fire in his honor?
options: His people made no fire in his honor
questions.correctAnswer: His people made no fire in his honor
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 21:19 (ESV): "...His people made no fire in his honor, like the fires made for his fathers."

key_verse_text: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. He departed with no one’s regret.
